description: Submit a third-party skill for an Oathe Scan behavioral security audit before installing it. Accepts any GitHub or ClawHub URL. Returns an audit_id to track progress. One submission per 60 seconds. 10 scans a month without an account. This server submits without an API key. Returns existing audit_id if URL was already scanned (deduplicated: true). Use check_audit_status to poll for results.

force_rescan.description: Bypass deduplication and force a fresh audit

notification_email.description: Optional email to notify when audit completes

skill_url.description: GitHub or ClawHub URL of the skill/repo to audit

name: submit_audit
